notes.content:
## Chapter 3: Algorithms and Problem Solving

This Class 11 Computer Science and Entrepreneurship study guide covers computational problems, algorithm design and analysis, sorting, searching and graph traversal. The supplied document includes 80 original board-style practice MCQs across eight topics, English explanations and Urdu explanations, study notes, examples, diagrams and a separate chapter practice test. It is a study resource, not a reproduced board examination paper.

## Topic-wise practice

- 3.1 Computational Problems
- 3.2 Generate-and-Test Method
- 3.3 Solvability and Tractability
- 3.4 Algorithm Analysis
- 3.5 Algorithm Design Techniques
- 3.6 Sorting Algorithms
- 3.6 Searching Algorithms
- 3.6 Graph Traversal (BFS and DFS)

The source uses section number 3.6 for sorting, searching and graph traversal. Their different names remain separate topics in the online question bank. Each topic contains ten supplied MCQs, with option order and correct-answer identity preserved before the quiz applies its usual per-attempt randomisation.

## Notes, examples and diagrams

Use the complete PDF for the chapter overview, teaching notes, algorithm examples, visual explanations, comparison tables and model short and long answers. Practise tracing an algorithm on a small input before checking its explanation. For a search example, identify the input, the target and the result. For a sorting example, record the list after each step so that you can explain how the order changes.

## Examination and source notice

The supplied guide labels its questions as original board-style practice and does not claim authenticated board/year repetitions. Its priority ratings are teaching estimates, not measured past-paper frequencies. The guide's 2027 syllabus notice identifies section 3.3.3 on P, NP, NP-hard and NP-complete, exercise MCQs 2 to 4 and long question 1 as excluded. Read the notice in the document and consult the applicable official syllabus when preparing for an examination. Do not confuse the guide's chapter practice test with the complete board-paper pattern.

## Original PDF preview and download

The PDF below is the exact 28-page file supplied for this chapter. It has not been recreated, compressed or edited. Its original layout, diagrams, highlighted correct answers, English and Urdu explanations and practice-test answer key remain intact. Preview it here or download the same file for offline revision.

For a self-test, attempt questions before reading the highlighted answers. Use the explanation to identify why the selected answer is correct, then revisit any algorithm steps that were unclear. The interactive website quiz keeps its existing result-stage feedback behaviour.

## Continue studying

Open [Computer Science MCQs](/classes/11th-class/computer-science/mcqs/) and choose Chapter 3 followed by a topic. Browse [Computer Science notes](/classes/11th-class/computer-science/notes/) for Chapters 1 and 2, or return to the [subject resource hub](/classes/11th-class/computer-science/).
